Package com.helix.core.reorder

Class RatioSortPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.reorder.RatioSortPolicy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReorderingPolicy
public class RatioSortPolicy extends Object implements ReorderingPolicy
Analytical baseline reordering policy sorting candidate clauses in ascending order of their cost-to-failure ratio (C_i / F_i).

Clauses with the lowest ratio (fastest to evaluate and most likely to fail) are placed first to maximize short-circuit probability.
